additional_cohorts.usage: Phone/OTP composition only; private/local-assets/onboarding-24 frames 4 and 10 inspected. Blue-indigo canvas is a provisional auth adaptation. Current native and historical auth evidence are not a single cohort.

measured_color_evidence.method: Median 5x5 unobstructed canvas patches in original JPEG; embedded ICC converted to sRGB with Pillow ImageCms where present. Provisional linear interpolation, not native token export.

membership_card.method: Embedded ICC converted to sRGB; individual unobstructed card pixels. Gradient is a target adapter, not a native token export.

phone_auth.method: Original unobstructed PNG samples; vertical interpolation and black endpoint are target adapters.

otp_auth.method: Original unobstructed PNG centre samples; no embedded ICC profile. Vertical interpolation is a target adapter; horizontal variation is not reproduced exactly.
otp_auth.cell_geometry: 40 by 48 logical pixels with 12-point corners, approximately scaled from source. Height expands for enlarged text.

retained_adaptations: Own club logos, names, data, football flows and routes.
Approved match photography remains a separate editorial object within its CMS match block; no photograph under score text.
Single native OTP field under six grouped visual cells preserves paste, autofill and screen reader editing.
